// coding-misk · Neon Rush · reel 28s
// song composed with sections and tracks: each track plays its clips, switched on by the section lane (1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade)
// each .analyze("…") lights up its instrument in the Stage visual
setcpm(145/4)

const SECTIONS = [['Crescendo', 9], ['Crescendo 2', 24], ['Glitch', 2], ['Build', 3], ['Drop', 8], ['Glitch break', 2], ['Final', 1], ['Hit', 1]]
const TEMPO = {'Crescendo': 145, 'Crescendo 2': 145, 'Glitch': 145, 'Build': 145, 'Drop': 145, 'Glitch break': 145, 'Final': 145, 'Hit': 145}

// section lanes: 1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade
const section1 = "<1!9 0!41>"  // Crescendo · 9 bars · 145 BPM · E · Em
const section2 = "<0!9 1!24 0!17>"  // Crescendo 2 · 24 bars · 145 BPM · E · Em C D B
const section3 = "<0!33 1!2 0!15>"  // Glitch · 2 bars · 145 BPM · E · Em C D B
const section4 = "<0!35 1!3 0!12>"  // Build · 3 bars · 145 BPM · E · Em C D B
const section5 = "<0!38 1!8 0!4>"  // Drop · 8 bars · 145 BPM · E · Em C D B

const section8 = "<0!49 1>"  // Hit · 1 bars · 145 BPM · E · Em C D B

// ========== drums ==========
// Crescendo · bars 1-9 · pattern C~1
// Drums · RolandTR909
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.9).distort(2.8).distortvol(.5).crush(10).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [cp ~ ~ ~] ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.72).distort(2.8).distortvol(.5).crush(10).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
